about.title: About me
about.lead: Psychologist with clinical training and experience in human talent management.
about.body: Over 3 years of experience in individual psychological care, diagnostic assessment using ICD-10 criteria, and mass recruitment processes for national engineering projects. I combine clinical intervention skills (CBT, crisis intervention) with human resources competencies.
about.ai: My clinical psychology training allows me to conduct rigorous assessments and accurate diagnoses, while my experience in talent management helps me understand organizational needs and contribute to team well-being.
